scholarships.name: International Scholarship Programme of the Avicenna Studienwerk
scholarships.description: The International Scholarship Programme (ISP) of the Avicenna Studienwerk, in cooperation with the Islamkolleg Deutschland, supports international Muslim students and doctoral candidates with funds from the Federal Foreign Office (Auswärtiges Amt, AA). The aim of the programme is to create optimal conditions for academic qualification, social commitment and personal development through financial and non-material support.
scholarships.deadlineText: The scholarships are awarded annually. Current deadlines can be found on the [programme website](https://www.avicenna-studienwerk.de/scholarship/#ISP-en).
